description: This Java class 'PickContact' is an Android activity demonstrating how to launch the contacts app to pick various types of contact information, handle the result, and display it with Toast notifications.

classes.name: PickContact
classes.description: An Activity that allows users to pick contacts or contact data and displays the selected URI and its associated ID.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and sets click listeners for contact selection buttons.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the contact picking activity, retrieves the contact URI, queries for the contact ID, and shows it in a Toast message.
